summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P 100 Equal Weight ETF (EQWL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 100 Equal Weighted index. The fund tracks the an equally-weighted index composed of the 100 largest companies in the US equity markets. EQWL was launched on Dec 1, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: EQWL is an equity ETF with a total of 104 individual holdings. The top holdings are Palo Alto Networks stock at 1.25%, Palantir Technologies at 1.24%, Intuitive Surgical at 1.20%, Accenture at 1.19%, and Advanced Micro Devices at 1.17%.
